# mobile: sensors, touch and device services

## Concepts
`forge::os::mobile` (`#include <forge/os/mobile.hpp>`, link `forge_mobile`) is one API for sensors, touch, haptics, display, cameras, audio, permissions, notifications and app lifecycle. Backends exist for Android, iOS/iPadOS, macOS, Windows, Linux (desktops and Linux phones such as PinePhone and Librem 5) and FreeBSD, plus a null backend and a JSON-trace simulator.

- **Errors.** Calls return `os::result<T>` / `os::status`. Anything a platform cannot do returns `os::unsupported(...)` (`is_unsupported(r.err)` is true). Nothing throws.
- **RAII.** `device`, `sensor_stream`, `touch_stream` and `subscription` are move-only owners. Dropping a stream stops the hardware.
- **Memory.** Event queues are bounded (4096 events; a full queue drops the oldest and counts it in `dropped()`) and allocate through `forge::mem::budget_resource(host_budget(), "mobile")`.
- **App glue.** Some things only Java, Swift or WndProc code can see. The app pushes them in through the glue functions below.

```cpp
namespace m = forge::os::mobile;
auto dev = m::device::open();                 // platform backend; FORGE_MOBILE_TRACE=trace.json selects the simulator
auto acc = dev->open_sensor(m::sensor_kind::accelerometer, 100);
for (auto& e : acc->poll(50)) use(e.v[0], e.v[1], e.v[2]);
auto touch = dev->open_touch();
for (auto& g : touch->gestures(16)) if (g.kind == m::gesture_kind::pinch) zoom(g.scale);
auto sub = dev->on_lifecycle([](m::app_event e) { if (e == m::app_event::background) save(); });
```

## API reference
| Area | API |
|---|---|
| Opening | `device::open()` (platform backend, or the simulator when `FORGE_MOBILE_TRACE` is set), `null_device()`, `simulated(json, realtime)`, `simulated_file(path, realtime)`, `linux_with(sysfs_root, input_dir)` (Linux, for tests), `backend_name()` |
| Sensors (16 kinds) | accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, light, proximity, pressure, location, battery, step_counter, step_detector, rotation_vector, gravity, linear_acceleration, heart_rate, temperature, humidity. `sensors()`, `has_sensor`, `open_sensor(kind, rate_hz)` (rate in (0, 10000]) → `sensor_stream` with `poll(timeout_ms, max)`, `dropped()`, `finished()`. `sensor_event::v` units are listed in the header |
| Touch | `open_touch()` → `touch_stream` with `poll` and `gestures`. `gesture_recognizer` (tap, double_tap, long_press, swipe, pinch, rotate) is a pure state machine you can feed yourself. Positions are in display pixels; `t_ns` is on the `monotonic_ns()` clock where the platform allows (evdev with `EVIOCSCLOCKID`, Windows QPC) |
| Location | `location` sensor (lat, lon, altitude, accuracy), `gnss()` (fix, satellites), `geofence_monitor` (`add`, `remove`, `feed`; haversine enter/exit, works on any backend that produces location) |
| Display | `display()`, `screen_orientation()`, `lock_orientation`, `brightness` / `set_brightness`, `keep_awake`, `show_keyboard` |
| Camera / audio | `cameras()` (capture devices only), `torch`, `capture_photo` (JPEG bytes), `record_audio(ms, rate)` (a hook that returns no `samples` is an error), `play_audio` (the hook receives `sample_rate`, `channels` and `samples`) |
| Haptics | `vibrate(ms, amplitude)` (ms in (0, 60000], amplitude in [0, 1]), `haptic_pattern({on, off, ...})` (falls back to repeated vibrate, waiting out each step even when the vibrator returns at once) |
| System | `power()`, `connectivity()`, `bluetooth_scan(timeout_ms)`, `nfc_available()`, `clipboard_get` / `clipboard_set`, `notify`, `biometrics()`, `info()` (incl. `form_factor`: phone, tablet, watch, tv, desktop, laptop, car), `paths()`, `open_url`, `share`. `open_url` takes only absolute URLs whose scheme is allowed (`http`, `https`, `mailto`, `tel` by default; `set_url_schemes` changes the list); paths, `file:`, `javascript:`, custom handlers, a leading `-`, spaces and control characters are refused before the hook or the OS opener sees them. `connectivity()` counts an interface as online only with a routable address (not link-local) and takes its transport from the kernel (Linux sysfs, BSD/macOS media type) before names |
| Permissions | `permission_status`, `request_permission` for sensors, location, camera, notifications, vibrate |
| Lifecycle | `on_lifecycle(cb)` → `subscription` for foreground, background, low_memory, terminate. `low_memory` calls `forge::mem::governor::on_pressure(critical)`, which drops every cache, whether or not anyone subscribed. Once a backend has a subscriber, `os::memory_pressure` critical events are reported as `low_memory` |
| Simulator | `sim_log()` returns the actions the simulator recorded |

App glue: `feed_touch`, `feed_sensor`, `provide_sensor(kind)`, `feed_lifecycle`, `report_display`, `report_permission`, `set_action_hooks({vibrate, notify, request_permission})`, `set_service_hook(fn(op, json_args) -> optional<json>)`, `android_feed_motion(AInputEvent*)` (Android), `windows_feed_pointer(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam)` (Windows). A service hook answers any device method by name (`"connectivity"`, `"torch"`, ...) with the same JSON shape as the simulator's `services` entries; returning `nullopt` falls through to the native backend. `provide_sensor(kind)` tells the device that the glue feeds `kind` (WinRT sensors, CoreLocation on macOS, GeoClue on Linux...): `open_sensor(kind)` then returns a stream fed by `feed_sensor` wherever the backend has no native source, and `sensors()` lists it.

## Backends
| OS | Native | Needs app glue or unsupported |
|---|---|---|
| Android (NDK, API 26+) | ASensorManager for accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, light, proximity, pressure, gravity, linear acceleration, rotation vector, humidity, ambient temperature, step detector/counter, heart rate. Rotation vector as the full quaternion (x, y, z, w). A failed `registerSensor` (permission, rate) is returned as an error. Battery from `os::power_status`. Touch from `android_feed_motion`. Cameras through ACameraManager. Device info and form factor from system properties (`ro.build.characteristics`) | Location (FusedLocationProvider → `feed_sensor`), display (`report_display`), vibrate, notify and permission requests (`set_action_hooks`), and clipboard, share, biometrics, brightness, torch and storage `paths` (filesDir, cacheDir: without the hook `paths()` is unsupported unless HOME and TMPDIR are set) through `set_service_hook` |
| iOS / iPadOS (`apple.mm`) | CoreMotion (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, and deviceMotion for `rotation_vector` (attitude quaternion x, y, z, w), `gravity` and `linear_acceleration` (user acceleration, m/s²); one shared CMMotionManager, each kind fanned out to every open stream), CMAltimeter (pressure), CMPedometer (`step_counter`: steps over CoreMotion's history since boot, at most 7 days; `step_detector`: 1 per new step, delivered in CMPedometer's batches), UIDevice proximity monitoring (`proximity`: 0 cm near, 5 cm far; iPhone), CoreLocation (stream ends when access is denied), UIDevice battery, UIPasteboard clipboard, touch through `FORGETouchView`, UIImpactFeedbackGenerator (short pulses on iPhone) and the AudioServices system vibration (longer pulses, other devices), UIScreen (display, brightness), idle-timer keep-awake, AVCapture cameras and torch, LAContext biometrics, UIDevice info (pad → tablet, TV, CarPlay), openURL, UNUserNotificationCenter, lifecycle and memory warnings | Light is not exposed by iOS. Pedometer and location need the usage-description keys (`NSMotionUsageDescription`, `NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription`); denied access returns not_supported or ends the stream. watchOS uses the null backend + glue |
| macOS (`apple.mm`) | CoreLocation (`location`, with a when-in-use authorization request; the manager lives on the main run loop and is created asynchronously from other threads, so nothing blocks), AVCaptureDeviceDiscoverySession cameras (built-in, external, Continuity Camera on 14+) and camera permission, LAContext Touch ID `biometrics()`, NSPasteboard clipboard, IOPMAssertion keep-awake, NSWorkspace `open_url`, notifications (UNUserNotificationCenter in bundled apps on 10.14+, `osascript` for command-line tools), device info (laptop when a battery is present, else desktop), plus the portable power and connectivity services | Trackpad touch through `feed_touch`; `provide_sensor(location)` + `feed_sensor` replaces CoreLocation. A command-line tool whose main thread never runs its run loop gets no location fixes. CoreBluetooth through the service hook |
| Windows | WM_POINTER touch and pen pressure (`windows_feed_pointer`: QPC timestamps, contact count from GetPointerFrameInfo), display (GetSystemMetrics, DPI, EnumDisplaySettings, rotation), battery, process-wide keep-awake through a power request (PowerCreateRequest / PowerSetRequest), `ShellExecuteW` `open_url`, Known Folders for `paths()` (redirected Documents/Downloads), SMBIOS manufacturer and model, form factor (`SM_CONVERTIBLESLATEMODE`, battery). Sensor API (`ISensorManager`): accelerometer (sign flipped to the Android/IIO convention), gyroscope, compass, ambient light, aggregated orientation as `rotation_vector`, barometer, humidity, temperature, human proximity, polled with `GetData`; access denied in Privacy settings is an error, a missing sensor unsupported. Media Foundation cameras (`MFEnumDeviceSources`; `id` is the symbolic link, `capture_photo` also takes `"0"`, `"1"`...): one frame through an `IMFSourceReader` converting to RGB32, JPEG from WIC. Brightness through WMI `WmiMonitorBrightness` (laptop panels), else DDC/CI (dxva2 `Get/SetMonitorBrightness`, primary monitor). Bluetooth classic inquiry (`BluetoothFindFirstDevice`, all radios; paired devices included, RSSI 0). WASAPI shared-mode `record_audio` / `play_audio` on the default endpoints, converted from/to the mix format. `notify` as a `Shell_NotifyIconW` balloon (a toast on Windows 10+) from a tray icon that stays while the device is open; no AUMID needed. All of it loaded at run time from System32 | Geolocation and BLE (WinRT only) through `provide_sensor` + `feed_sensor` / the service hook |
| Linux | IIO sensors found by channel attribute name (`in_<type>[<index>][_<modifier>]_{raw,input}`: accel, anglvel, magn, gravity, illuminance, proximity, pressure, temp (ambient preferred), humidityrelative, steps, `rot_quaternion` as `rotation_vector`; scale/offset per channel, stem or type), power_supply battery, location through GeoClue2 (system D-Bus via sd-bus from `libsystemd.so.0` at run time; DesktopId `forge`, the desktop's GeoClue agent must allow it), V4L2 `capture_photo` (one MJPEG/JPEG frame through mmap streaming, the standard Huffman tables added when the camera omits them; YUV-only cameras are unsupported), backlight brightness (firmware over platform over raw) with logind `Session.SetBrightness` when sysfs is not writable, `keep_awake` through a logind `idle:sleep` block inhibitor held until `keep_awake(false)`, evdev touchscreens (protocol B and single touch; every node with `INPUT_PROP_DIRECT`, so touchpads are skipped; `EVIOCGABS` ranges scaled to the DRM display size), force-feedback rumble, DRM / fbdev display with accelerometer orientation, V4L2 capture cameras (`VIDIOC_QUERYCAP`; UVC metadata and m2m nodes are skipped), backlight brightness, LED-flash torch, `/sys/class/nfc`, NetworkManager (`nmcli -t -e yes`) and ModemManager (`mmcli`), BlueZ (`bluetoothctl`) scan (devices heard during the scan, RSSI 0 when not advertised), fprintd biometrics, DMI / device-tree info (form factor from DMI chassis type or the DT `chassis-type`; a DT board without one is a phone only with a battery and a touchscreen), XDG user dirs (`user-dirs.dirs`) for `paths()`, `arecord` / `aplay`, `notify-send`. Permissions are `not_required` | `FORGE_MOBILE_SYSFS` and `FORGE_MOBILE_INPUT` relocate the sysfs and input trees; D-Bus services (GeoClue2, logind) are only used with the live `/sys` |
| FreeBSD | Temperature from `dev.cpu.0.temperature` or the ACPI thermal zone, ACPI battery, evdev touchscreens (`INPUT_PROP_DIRECT`, monotonic clock, scaled once `report_display` gives the size), brightness through backlight(9) (`/dev/backlight/backlight*`, `BACKLIGHTGETSTATUS` / `BACKLIGHTUPDATESTATUS`, FreeBSD 13+; writing needs access to the node). `keep_awake`: FreeBSD has no idle inhibitor, so only under X11 (`DISPLAY` set, `xset` installed) the screen saver and DPMS are switched off and the earlier `xset q` settings restored afterwards (a crash leaves them off until X restarts); unsupported otherwise | Display through `report_display`; devd hot-plug forwarded by the app |
| null | — | Everything unsupported |

## Simulator (JSON trace)
`device::simulated(json)`, `simulated_file(path)` or `FORGE_MOBILE_TRACE=<file>`. Keys:

| Key | Content |
|---|---|
| `display`, `sensors`, `cameras`, `permissions` | Static device description |
| `services` | One entry per service op (`power`, `connectivity`, `bluetooth_scan`, `info`, `gnss`, `clipboard`, `brightness`, `photo`, `audio`, ...). A missing op returns unsupported |
| `events` | `sensor`, `touch`, `orientation` and `lifecycle` events, each with `t_ms` |

Actions (vibrate, notify, torch, open_url, ...) are recorded in `sim_log()` and honour `permissions`; for example `torch` fails when camera permission is denied. With `realtime = true` events are replayed at their `t_ms`.

## Platform status and tests
| Platform | Status |
|---|---|
| Linux x86_64 | `test_mobile` (simulator, gestures incl. pinch/rotate, services, lifecycle → memory pressure, geofencing, `open_url` policy, glue-provided sensors, audio/haptic hooks, XDG user dirs, Linux backend on a fake sysfs + evdev FIFO incl. touchpad and UVC-metadata exclusion; IIO channel naming, magnetometer/pressure/humidity/ambient temperature/indexed light/quaternion and backlight choice on a second fake tree; helper tests for resampling, MJPEG Huffman tables (checked against libjpeg's), IIO names and `xset q`) and `test_script` `mobile_sensors_touch` pass. On WSL2 the live backend reports GeoClue2 absent (unsupported) and takes and releases a logind inhibitor |
| Windows 11 (MinGW build, desktop) | `windows_native_services`: Sensor API present with no sensors (only battery listed, the rest unsupported), no cameras, DDC/CI brightness read (never set), no Bluetooth radio and no microphone (unsupported), 50 ms of silence played through WASAPI, one tray notification with `FORGE_UI_TESTS=1`. Camera capture, Sensor API reads, WMI brightness and Bluetooth inquiry compile and skip without the hardware |
| FreeBSD 14.5 (VM) | `test_mobile` passes; no `/dev/backlight` (unsupported), `keep_awake` unsupported without `DISPLAY` |
| Windows (MSVC), macOS arm64 | `test_mobile` passes in CI. It exercises the simulator and the backend's `open()`, not real sensors |
| Android | CI builds `test_script`, `test_mobile`, `test_locale` and `test_text` for x86_64 with the NDK and runs them on an API 34 emulator. Not run against real sensors or on a device |
| iOS / iPadOS | The CI `ios` job compiles `forge_mobile` (the UIKit part of `apple.mm`) and `forge_text` for the device SDK; nothing runs on a device or simulator |

With `zig` installed, `xos_mobile_<target>` compiles every C++ backend for FreeBSD, macOS, MinGW and aarch64 musl.
